species.name: Тубус Sororibus
species.description: Скопления полых стеблей образуют группы вертикальных колоний. Органы размножения прикрыты верхушками.
species.description_en: Clustered hollow stalk structures forming grouped vertical colonies with capped reproductive growth.

species.name: Тубус Rosarium
species.description: Компактные трубчатые шпили с растрескивающимися репродуктивными коробочками на верхних сегментах.
species.description_en: Compact tubular spires with explosive reproductive pods distributed along upper segments.

species.name: Тубус Cavas
species.description: Вертикальные стебли из бледных сегментированных трубок с внутренними полостями для газообмена.
species.description_en: Vertical stalk system composed of pale segmented tubes with internal gas exchange cavities.

species.name: Тубус Compagibus
species.description: Сильно сегментированная трубчатая структура. Между сегментами роста плотно переплетаются листовидные отростки.
species.description_en: Highly segmented tubular structure with dense interlocking fronds between growth modules.

species.name: Тубус Conifer
species.description: Высокие полые цилиндры с перевёрнутыми кронами, рассеивающими семена на большой площади.
species.description_en: Tall hollow cylindrical structures capped with inverted crowns for wide-area seed dispersal.

species.name: Дерновина Albata
species.description: Полосатые листья с раздвоенными отростками. Вторичные листья вырабатывают споры.
species.description_en: Striped leaf structure with bifurcated growth patterns and spore-producing secondary leaves.

matchContextNotes: High Metal Content added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 1,051 of 4,502 bodies with it in the EDDN year are High Metal Content (23 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.name: Дерновина Capillum
species.description: Плотные пучки волосовидных листьев с коробочковидными органами размножения.

matchContextNotes: Rocky Ice added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 1,556 of 1,724 bodies with it in the EDDN year are Rocky Ice (90 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.description: Сегментированные нижние листья и вытянутые верхние структуры, образующие скопления спор.

species.name: Дерновина Catena

matchContextNotes: High Metal Content added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 1,108 of 4,234 bodies with it in the EDDN year are High Metal Content (26 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.name: Дерновина Divisa
species.description: Сочетание сегментированных и вытянутых листьев, образующее бледные споры.
species.description_en: Hybrid structure of segmented and elongated leaves with pale spore outputs.

species.name: Дерновина Ignis
species.description: Плотные переплетённые пучки листьев с прямостоячими семенными стеблями.

matchContextNotes: High Metal Content added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 1,351 of 8,380 bodies with it in the EDDN year are High Metal Content (16 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.name: Дерновина Pennata
species.description: Из скоплений листьев выступают перьевидные структуры для рассеивания семян.

species.name: Дерновина Pennatis
species.description: Центральный сегментированный стебель окружён перьевидными отростками.
species.description_en: Segmented central stalk surrounded by feather-like growth formations.

matchContextNotes: High Metal Content added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 966 of 5,565 bodies with it in the EDDN year are High Metal Content (17 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.name: Дерновина Propagito
species.description: Сужающиеся листья с разноцветными семенными коробочками на концах.
species.description_en: Tapered leaf structures with colorful seed pod tips.

species.name: Дерновина Serrati
species.description: Зубчатые листья с тёмными репродуктивными коробочками.
species.description_en: Serrated leaf structures with dark reproductive pods.

matchContextNotes: High Metal Content added 2026-11-03 (hand list vs data): 624 of 3,063 bodies with it in the EDDN year are High Metal Content (20 %); the row left it out and only the observed-class rescue showed it.

species.name: Дерновина Stigmasis
species.description: Жёсткие травянистые пучки с дисковидными семенными коробочками на высоких стеблях.
species.description_en: Wiry grass-like clusters with disc-shaped seed pods on tall stalks.

species.name: Дерновина Triticum
species.description: Тонкие полосатые листья с высокими семенными стеблями для рассеивания семян ветром.
species.description_en: Thin striped leaves with elevated seed stalks for wind dispersal.

source.what: Which colour variant each species takes, and whether it is set by the parent star class or by a material on the body.
source.status: Community knowledge, not a proprietary dataset — the same tables the codex teaches anyone who scans enough plants.
source.transcribedFrom: https://ed-dsn.net/en/exobiological-flora/ (retrieved 2026-09-11), to save typing several hundred rows by hand.
source.verifiedAgainst: CMDR FALrenica's own journals: 235 star-table predictions correct and none wrong, and in all 47 material rows the colour he found was among the candidates.
source.gameCodex: bySpecies rebuilt 2026-09-26 from the game's own codex list (every variant's symbol and English name, as published by Canonn's codex reference). ED-DSN had 3 wrong rows (Fumerola carbosis tin; Recepta deltahedronix mercury and molybdenum) and 36 missing; genus tables (byGenus) now only cover species the list does not name.

verification.againstOwnerJournals: 235 star-table predictions correct, 0 wrong, 23 classes blank; 47 of 47 material rows had the observed colour among the candidates.
verification.materialTieBreak: Withdrawn 2026-09-22. An EDDN capture of 25,858 bodies carries 14,502 codex entries whose variant suffix names the deciding material outright; on the 907 bodies where more than one of a species' own materials was present, the rarest won 445 and lost 462. A fixed per-species priority fails too — every species shows contradictory pairs. It is not a ranking of the materials at all, so both candidates are offered again. The earlier 14-of-15 came from a single commander's 15 finds.

corpusFills.note: Star classes ED-DSN leaves blank that the owner has scanned himself, or that the game's own variant tokens settle (EDDN codex entries, 2026-10-03: a body round a neutron star logs Tussock _F 14 of 14 and Stratum _F 2 of 2). Listed separately so a later ED-DSN update can overwrite them without touching the transcription. singleVariant: species the game has one colour of (EDSM's codex lists one variant), whatever the star.

speciesBands.source: EDDN complete-list bodies first seen before 2026-09 (docs/perf/formula/train.parquet)

speciesSplit.built: 2026-10-10 from docs/perf/formula fit v5 (EDDN complete-list bodies before 2026-09); Cactoida and Recepta dropped 2026-10-11 (sealed sample c: first in genus -13/-8 and -12/-11)

genusBodySplit.source: Spansh galaxy dump bodies where the EDSM + EDAstro codex log exactly one species of the genus in the system and the body is the only one there with it. Built by docs/perf/build_genus_body_split.py. Plus every Brain Tree and Sinuous Tubers body of the EDDN year (codex and on-foot, EDGalaxyData archive), added by docs/perf/split-eddn-eval.mts.

observedTemperature.source: Spansh galaxy dump bodies with a species the EDSM + EDAstro codex confirms there, against each species' feeder-profile temperature envelope. Built by docs/perf/build_observed_temperature.py.

firmTemperatureEdges.about: Temperature edges no species body of the EDDN year (2025-10-08..2026-10-07, eddn.duckdb) lies past: a round number with >= 1 % of the species' bodies within 1 K of it, >= 1,000 bodies (docs/perf/calibration/firm_edges_scan.py --write). A row past one is demoted and not brought back to fill the signal count (matchSpecies.ts, firmTemperatureEdges.ts).

eddnTemperatureRange.source: EDDN year (EDGalaxyData archive) without hold-outs A/B, each species logged on the exact body; journal SurfaceTemperature. Lone outliers beyond a codex edge never set the range (outlier-register.json). Built by docs/perf/build_eddn_temperature_range.py.

hostStarSeen.source: Spansh galaxy dump bodies where the EDSM + EDAstro codex log exactly one species of the genus in the system and the body is the only one there with it; the host star's subType (the body's parent star, else the main star). Built by docs/perf/build_host_star_seen.py.

colourStarNever.source: EDDN year (EDGalaxyData archive), each species logged on the exact body; colour star = the app's colourStarTypeFor (brightest star in the body's sky). Built by docs/perf/build_colour_star_never.py. 1.2.19: pairs from 10 expected and species from 100 bodies, none in hold-outs A / B / D.

starlightRanges.source: Spansh galaxy_bio dump (DSS-mapped bio bodies) x EDSM codex dump + EDAstro codex-data.csv; docs/perf/star-flux-ranges.mts + star-flux-analyse.py

measuredExclusions.source: EDDN year (342k bodies, each species logged on the exact body) + hold-outs A/B/D + the owner's journals: no confirmed body of the species inside any rule. Values: temp K, mass Earth masses, parent = the journal Parents[0] kind (Star / Null / Planet), sma_ls semi-major axis in light-seconds, orb_d orbital period in days, dist_ls distance from arrival, grav_g g, c_metal metal fraction, host = the parent star's class, main = the system main star's class (hostStarClassKey), region = galactic region. Built by docs/perf/build_measured_exclusions.py.

chanceCalibration.source: EDDN year hold-outs A + B (8,000 bodies each), complete bodies, signal count known; app run app48
chanceCalibration.note: per band: [rows, came true, mean chance said]; genus '*' = all genera

chanceRecalibration.about: FSS chance correction (owner 2026-11-02): per genus, shown chance -> how often rows at that chance came true on fully identified bodies of the EDDN year (docs/perf/calibration/recal_fit.py; 5 % bins pulled toward the shown % by 20 pseudo-rows, monotone). Points are [shown, real] as fractions; linear between them. Before a DSS only; rows at 99.5 % or more are left alone; the result stays between 1 % and 99.5 %, so no row is added or hidden. A genus with fewer than 150 rows uses the pooled map.

rarity.source: Codex data provided by EDSM (https://www.edsm.net), nightly codex dump: distinct systems per species (all colours) galaxy-wide and per region.

bodyShare.source: Spansh galaxy_bio dump (DSS-mapped bio bodies, type = planet class|atmosphere) x EDSM codex dump + EDAstro codex-data.csv (which species of a genus). Data provided by EDSM and EDAstro.

variantRegions.source: EDAstro codex-data.csv (edastro.com, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), distinct systems per codex id; codex-data.csv
